<p><i><b>What You'll Do</b></i></p><br /><p>• Provide advanced technical support to customers across Splunk Cloud technologies, resolving issues across a broad range of complexity.</p><p>• Own complex technical cases from investigation through resolution, coordinating with customers, partners, Engineering, and internal interested parties.</p><p>• Operate independently on most cases, collaborating and consulting with others when issues span multiple products, technologies, or systems.</p><p>• Support premium offers and solution support with a systems-level understanding of integrated architectures and customer environments.</p><p>• Submit effective critical issues with complete and accurate information; identify and submit bugs, defects, and quality critical issues.</p><p>• Build complex lab setups and customer recreates to reproduce, isolate, and resolve technical problems of diverse scope and complexity.</p><p>• Read and interpret user documentation, functional specifications, and RFCs to guide solving and solution design.</p><p>• Leverage software, diagnostic, AI-assisted automation, and other tools to improve resolution speed, accuracy, productivity, and quality.</p><p>• Apply TAC policies and procedures independently and maintain high-quality user documentation throughout the case lifecycle.</p><p>• Produce and share intellectual capital, including scripts, digital signatures, documentation, and training, for internal audiences, Global Delivery Partners, and customers.</p><p>• Contribute to continuous improvement and product quality by identifying recurring issues, enhancement opportunities, and resolution patterns.</p><p>• Participate in shift coverage aligned with TAC operational requirements.</p><p><i> </i></p><p><i> </i></p><p><i><b>Who You'll Work With</b></i></p><br /><p>• Customers and partners, to understand technical environments, set expectations, and take ownership for customer success.</p><p>• Engineering and internal customers, to resolve complex issues, submit product-quality feedback, and improve solutions.</p><p>• TCEs, Global Delivery Partners, CAP Managers, and TAC Technical Leaders, to share expertise, align case strategy, and scale standard processes.</p><p><i> </i></p><p><i> </i></p><p><i><b>Who You Are</b></i></p><br /><p>• A senior technical consultant who is an expert in at least one area and has broad knowledge across the relevant technology and complete solution.</p><p>• An independent problem solver who applies systems-level thinking to increasingly complex and integrated solutions.</p><p>• A clear communicator and relationship builder who takes ownership for customer success and can act as a liaison between field teams and Engineering.</p><p>• A collaborative peer who mentors junior TCEs, shares knowledge, and influences case strategy and resolution quality across teams.</p><p>• A curious, adaptable technologist who uses labs, AI, software, automation, and diagnostic tools to improve technical outcomes.</p><p><i> </i></p><p> </p><p><b>Our minimum requirements </b></p><br /><p>• 5 years of related experience or Bachelor's degree with 3 years of experience</p><p>• Demonstrated advanced technical support experience in Cloud related technologies including solving integrated solutions.</p><p>• Flexibility to support either Shift 3 (06:30–15:30 CST/CDT) or Shift 4 (10:30–19:30 CST/CDT), ensuring seamless coverage aligned with TAC operational requirements.</p><p><i> </i></p><p><b>Desired Skills </b></p><br /><p>• Experience building lab environments and customer recreates to isolate defects and reproduce complex issues.</p><p>• Working knowledge of software, AI-assisted automation, diagnostic tools, AWS, Kubernetes, Linux, and Splunk product deployment or solving</p><p>• Technical writing and knowledge-sharing skills, including scripts, digital signatures, documentation, and training.</p><p>• Ability to mentor peers and collaborate across teams to improve resolution quality and customer outcomes.</p><p>• Professional-level certification (for example, Splunk Certs) or equivalent relevant certification.</p><p><i>
